The '''Vault 33 engineer''' is a resident of [[Vault 33]] {{In|FOTV}}.

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Head]]===
At a general meeting of the Vault's governing council, the engineer reports that the Vault's [[Water chip (TV series)|water chip]] is broken.

===[[The Innovator]]===
In [[Vault 33]], [[Betty Pearson]] discusses plans to repair the [[Water chip (TV series)|water chip]] with the engineer. The engineer witnesses her exchange with [[Reg McPhee]], and quips with Betty about the challenges of leadership.

==Appearances==
The Vault 33 engineer appears only {{in|FOTV}}.
